gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kosugi-maru: Chunky pixels with a grin. Kosugi Maru follows in rounded, glowing strokes that never bunch up, so a long stretch of text keeps drifting along easily.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kumbh-sans: Pixelify Sans looks like a game console boot screen, blocky, loud and full of attitude. It earns its keep big and brief, over Kumbh Sans.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-lato: Pixelify Sans stamps out stems and crossbars of one uniform thickness, like pixels on a grid. Lato counters with wide, gently curved s shapes that read smoothly, so one grabs attention and the other holds it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin reads crisp and sturdy, its c terminals flaring out slightly. Over a long passage it stays comfortable and unfussy, while Pixelify Sans up top draws with the plain line of a fixed-width stencil brush.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-line-seed-jp: LINE Seed JP reads friendly and level, its horizontals as heavy as its verticals, with counters the eye slips through. Pixelify Sans grabs attention; this sans-serif does the quiet carrying.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-livvic: Pixel-built and cheeky. Shrink Pixelify Sans too far and its blocky charm blurs, while Livvic, a sans-serif with unstressed curves and a generous c, would happily take more size.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-lunasima: Bent-paperclip strokes, bold and playful. Lunasima follows as a sans-serif whose c tips never creep toward touching, a tidy answer to Pixelify Sans, which earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-lxgw-marker-goth: Pixelify Sans cuts every line to a single width, like sign-shop vinyl, and the effect is loud and instantly recognizable. LXGW Marker Gothic loosens things with a wide-open c and light modulation, so a long read flows smoothly.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-1: Pixelify Sans draws its c as open as a bent paperclip, loud and unmistakably digital. And M PLUS 1, a plain sans with big open eyes on e and a, steps in with the flat line of a fineliner.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-1p: M PLUS 1p reads open at every curve end, a sans that lets each letter breathe. And its best quality is how happily it sits beneath Pixelify Sans, whose round letters have rims matching the stems.
